name: Planetary Nebula
desc: The glowing shroud a dying sun-like star casts off — nested ionization shells of gas, a hot blue-white core fading through teal oxygen to a red hydrogen ring, drawn out into soft bipolar lobes and lit from within by the ember of a white dwarf, the whole shell slowly breathing.
